committees.name: Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs Committee

dimensions.assessment: Affects DHS personnel, ELO Office staff, partner agencies, and law enforcement entities engaged in information sharing.
dimensions.evidence: realign the essential functions and personnel of the ELO Office within the Partner Engagement directorate of I&A.

dimensions.assessment: Reorganizes internal DHS office structures and restricts budget or staffing expansions until the reorganization plan is certified.
dimensions.evidence: the Secretary may not (1) expand the staffing, budget, or programmatic scope of the ELO Office

dimensions.assessment: Requires cost-benefit estimates within the reorganization plan, but does not allocate new federal funds.
dimensions.evidence: Organizational analysis justifying the reorganization and realignment, including cost-benefit estimates

dimensions.assessment: Mandates structural reorganization, personnel reassignments, new communication protocols, and temporary statutory restrictions on agency expansion.
dimensions.evidence: comprehensive plan to carry out... An identification of redundant or non-essential positions... Realign the essential functions and personnel

dimensions.assessment: Imposes immediate transitional planning and restriction mandates leading to a permanent internal restructuring once certified.
dimensions.evidence: Not later than 120 days after the date of the enactment of this Act, the Secretary shall submit... a comprehensive plan

missing_information: Specific budget figures allocated to the ELO Office currently or under future reorganization
Exact number of positions deemed redundant or non-essential
importance_detail.rationale: This bill requires the Department of Homeland Security to develop a comprehensive plan to reorganize its Engagement, Liaison, and Outreach (ELO) Office, realign its functions, and places statutory limitations on ELO staffing and budgets until the plan and certification are submitted.
